svg.data-weight-note: 7.8 kg (17.2 lb) without power supplies or fans
svg.data-acoustics: 48.5 dBA at 40% fan speed, 64.9 dBA at 70% fan speed, and 77.8 dBA at 100% fan speed
svg.data-power-supply-options: 500W AC, 650W AC, 930W DC, or 1200W HVAC/HVDC (up to 2)
svg.data-optics-sfp28: installation guide: "48 10/25-Gigabit SFP+ downlink ports that support 1-Gigabit, 10-Gigabit, and 25-Gigabit Ethernet". SFP-10G-T-X is supported only in a stated checkerboard of ports, with the neighbours limited to passive copper.
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: installation guide: "six fixed 40/100-Gigabit QSFP28 uplink ports that support combinations of 10-, 25-, 40-, 50-, and 100-Gigabit connectivity".
svg.data-usb-limit: USB 2.0 devices that use less than 2.5 W (0.5 A inclusive of surge current)
svg.data-regulatory: Products should comply with CE Markings according to directives 2004/108/EC and 2006/95/EC
svg.data-safety: UL 60950-1 Second Edition, CAN/CSA-C22.2 No. 60950-1 Second Edition, EN 60950-1 Second Edition, IEC 60950-1 Second Edition, AS/NZS 60950-1, GB4943
svg.data-emissions: 47CFR Part 15 (CFR 47) Class A, AS/NZS CISPR22 Class A, CISPR22 Class A, EN55022 Class A, ICES003 Class A, VCCI Class A, EN61000-3-2, EN61000-3-3, KN22 Class A, CNS13438 Class A
